name: Campingplatz Kaseler
beschreibung: The Kaseler campsite is located in the village of Ginzling in the Zemmtal, a side valley of the Zillertal in Tirol. The site has a quiet and close-to-nature atmosphere. The immediate surroundings are dominated by the peaks of the Zillertaler Alpen; the grounds border the Naturpark Zillertaler Alpen. Numerous marked hiking trails, including to the Berliner Hütte, start near the campsite. In winter, the ski areas around Mayrhofen can be reached by car. The campsite's facilities include sanitary facilities, electric hookups, and a lounge. Guests can expect accommodation with direct access to the high alpine mountain world and the infrastructure of a family-run campsite.
